correctness.rationale: Let R_j=(b^j-1)/(b-1), g_i=R_n+aR_{i-1}, a≥1,b,n≥2,gcd(a,R_n)=1. For replacement kg_1=∑_{i≥2}u_i g_i, coprimality gives E=∑u_iR_{i-1}=tR_n and k=at+L; E≤L R_{n-1}<L R_n/b implies L≥bt+1, k≥a+b+1. At the minimal k equality forces one g_2 and b g_n (for n=2, (b+1)g_2); deficit bound <2b^(n-2) proves uniqueness, so the critical catenary lower bound a+b+1 is forced by two disjoint factorizations. The cited full toric-ideal 2x2-minor generators all have both fragment lengths ≤a+b+1 and yield a chain in every fiber, proving the matching global upper bound. Independently enumerated 29 small coprime parameter critical fibers, no shorter pure replacements, and unique pair. No assertion for monotone or equal-length catenary degree.
